name: shadcn/ui
description: Blocks of shadcn/ui: application shells, authentication pages and a dashboard, built with React, Radix and Tailwind. Only their structure and content are rebuilt here, with the design system's components and tokens.
changes: Rebuilt as static HTML with the design system's component templates; every color, type style, radius, border and spacing comes from its tokens.
The original visual design (Tailwind classes, the Geist font) is not reused.
Lucide and Tabler icons are remapped to Material Symbols; brand logos (Apple, Google, GitHub, Meta) are dropped, the buttons keep their text.
Placeholder images are drawn with semantic tokens.
No script: behaviour that needs JavaScript (collapsing the sidebar, toasts, drag and drop, client-side tables) is dropped or simplified, and each screen says so.
